title: Beef Stir Fry with Turkish Flair
description: A quick and flavorful dish that combines the richness of velvety sauce with the bold flavors of Turkish spices, all wrapped up in a savory beef stir fry.

ingredients.name: Stir-fry vegetables (such as broccoli, carrots, and snap peas)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and cook until they are tender but still crisp, about 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Turkish spice blend and velvety sauce.
Pour the sauce over the beef and vegetables and stir to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
